prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Create ONE production city-map building sprite for tianshu, early-to-middle Qing Jiangnan region, 17th–18th century. The supplied Song Jiangnan image is a REFERENCE for the realistic material detail density and camera, NOT an edit target: generate an entirely new building of the stated type. Orthographic camera yaw45 elevation30; 2:1 dimetric ground projection, BOTH ground axes slopes precisely +0.5 and -0.5, verticals upright, parallel edges, NO perspective. Original South-facing entrance faces screen LOWER LEFT. True transparent RGBA background, all subject and short contact shadow completely inside canvas with at least 10% transparent margins. Very thin flat rectangular ground footprint with all three front ground corners clear; no thick diorama plinth. Realistic ancient architecture sprite, softly weathered off-white lime plaster, charcoal gray small fired clay roof tiles, gray brick/stone bases, dark timber and fine wood lattice windows. Modest Qing-style brick gate surrounds and restrained small carved trim; no ubiquitous imperial gilding, no giant ornamental roof curls. Light screen UPPER LEFT, small soft contact shadow screen LOWER RIGHT. NO sky, horizon, landscape, road outside footprint, humans, animals, calligraphy, labels, pseudo-writing, numbers, signage, watermark, checkers, plastic, cartoon, modern objects. This is an original generic game composite inspired by regional surviving Ming/Qing architectural forms, NOT a restoration of a named monument. Subject: ONE Qing Jiangnan Buddhist temple worship hall, only the main rectangular hall not a courtyard compound. Three timber bays, deep eaves with restrained bracket groups, single hip-and-gable gray tiled roof, modest corner uplift, warm dark red-brown columns, quiet white plaster side wall with gray-brick foot, dark lattice front doors; low-saturation floral beam painting only under eaves, NOT lavish northern official imperial motifs. Low stone dais and broad three-step entry inside very thin rectangular footprint, one small unlettered bronze incense vessel at front side. No Buddha statue outside, no pagoda, no enclosing yard wall. Footprint EAST-WEST14m NORTH-SOUTH11m, near-square plan14:11. TWO GROUND AXES slope exactly+0.500,-0.500; keep front ground corner horizontally56 percent along left-right footprint span, side edge visibly deep. Fully isolated intact building, no background.

visual_review: 已view_image逐张自查两候选并复核成品，选第一张：单殿灰瓦、红棕木柱与克制局部花卉梁枋，白灰墙清楚，无黄瓦金龙和文字；香器不挡门，完整屋檐与地面。第二张右侧阴影过长，第一张接触影更利拼接；左侧底轴偏平，严格2:1仍未通过。仅等比规格化，保留candidate。
